about: Places where Slayer tasks can be done. Built by tools/wiki-extract/build_slayer_areas.py and safe to edit by hand.

key is the stable id used by the plugin. areaId is the game's own Slayer area id (SLAYER_AREA varp and SlayerArea COL_AREA_ID), set only for places the game knows as a Slayer area. Konar's assignments are matched on it.
Points are [x, y, plane] in real game coordinates. entrance is the world map marker point. tasks[].spots are spawn tiles used as Shortest Path targets.
cannon is yes or no, combat is multi, single or mixed. Leave a fact out when it is not known. Every point and fact needs a source.

taskLocations lists every place for a task in display order, the recommended one first. recommended is the place to suggest when the master leaves the place open: the place the dossier's best location names, else the first listed place with a verified point. The player can pick another listed place in the sidebar.

wildernessTaskLocations lists where each of Krystilia's tasks can be done, from her wiki page, which names only places in the Wilderness. Its marker points and kill spots replace the place's own: each one is checked to lie in the Wilderness, and the place's facts and notes still apply.
